Definition
[The time vector field] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0454 ↗ def:chow-ii-vertical-frame-fields 1. appf:F.29\group Ricci-Flow Frame Bundle

For a Ricci flow $g(t)$, define on $\mathcal F\mathcal M\times [0,T)$ \[ \nabla _t=\frac{\partial }{\partial t}+R_{ab}g^{bc}\Lambda ^a_c. \] Its restriction to the evolving orthonormal frame bundle is the unique vector field tangent to that bundle whose spatial correction is vertical and normal to each time slice $\mathcal O\mathcal M_{g(t)}$.
